+def is_seed_subject_string(seed: str) -> TypeGuard[SeedSubjectString]:
+    """Return whether ``seed`` has a recognized subject type prefix."""
+    return seed.startswith(tuple(f"{subject_type}:" for subject_type in _SUBJECT_TYPES))
+
+
+def normalize_subject_seed(key: str) -> SeedSubjectString:
+    """Normalize a subject path or pseudo key into a canonical seed string."""
+    subject = key.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    if is_seed_subject_string(subject):
+        subject_type, value = subject.split(":", 1)
+    else:
+        subject_type, value = "subject", subject
+    value = value.replace(",", "_")
+    while "__" in value:
+        value = value.replace("__", "_")
+    return SeedSubjectString(f"{subject_type}:{value}")
+
